parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, facility ban, police targeting, or birth-sex custody rule is documented. Detention is case-by-case, ordinary-section requests are generally granted, and no birth-sex placement is codified, reducing tier-1 exposure if detained. Hate-crime aggravation for change of sex, an equality body handling complaints, and overwhelming legislative support for declaration-based recognition and marriage indicate an accepting institutional climate in a functioning state. However, resident-facing recognition and employment law are only climate signals for a visitor; no traveller-facing remedy outcome, border-document practice, facilities practice, or violence-enforcement record is documented, and nonbinary markers are unavailable domestically. That thin traveller evidence, rather than any known exposure, keeps the rating below 0.85.
